name: Home Screen widget
description: A small and medium Home Screen widget in a WidgetKit extension that shows a snapshot the app publishes through a shared App Group.

cost.note: Apple frameworks only; App Groups need a developer account for device builds

usage: From the app, publish what the widget should show with `WidgetSnapshotStore.publish(WidgetSnapshot(title:value:detail:))` whenever the underlying data changes; it saves to the App Group and reloads the widget timeline. The widget shows the latest snapshot, or a placeholder until the app has published one. Edit `SummaryWidgetView` in `Capabilities/HomeScreenWidget/Widget/` for the design.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify home-screen-widget` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
